description: Every reporter names the same items, ID paths, and reasons (ADR 01180), through the real CLI. A reporter only runs after every spec in its own run finishes, so each test runs one case of reporter-parity.cjs, which runs a nested doc-detective in .tmp/frp/<case>/ and checks what each reporter wrote. The mixed case browses the 8092 test server in headless Chrome.

tests.description: Headless Chrome with one passing test, one failing find, and one test that runOn skips: terminal, JUnit, Markdown, and both HTML copies name the same failing and skipped ID paths, and each one's media resolve from where the file sits.
--json -r junit,markdown,html: stdout parses as JSON, and stderr has the three announcement lines.
--no-auto-screenshot --no-auto-record -r junit,markdown: no run folder, so no [[ATTACHMENT| lines and no Run artifacts line.
-l warning -r junit: no JUnit report: line, and junit.xml exists.
